body: 🪢 Open source AI engineering platform: AI Gateway, agent observability, evals, and prompt/skill management, built on OpenTelemetry. One open platform for every AI call and every agent. Self-host or use Langfuse Cloud.
plain_description: **See how AI is used across your business and improve the results.** Track model usage, cost, and quality, and inspect agent activity. Manage prompts, run evaluations, and deploy on Langfuse Cloud or your own infrastructure.
technical_description: Langfuse is an open source AI engineering platform for observability, evaluations, prompt and skill management, and an AI Gateway. It ingests OpenTelemetry traces and supports SDKs, APIs, and integrations with AI frameworks and model providers. Deploy through Langfuse Cloud, Docker Compose, Kubernetes with Helm, or other listed infrastructure options.
title: Langfuse
